name: What's the difference between an AI-crawlable website and a regular one?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between an AI-crawlable website and a regular one?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Compare AI-crawlable sites by checking HTML clarity, schema depth (entity-based vs. basic), Core Web Vitals scores, and whether robots.txt allows GPTBot/ClaudeBot. AI-ready sites also use llms.txt and have fast, server-rendered content.

DIY tools miss log-level access issues and granular schema needs. Professionals offer staging tests, CI/CD automation, and quarterly audits.

Key factors: rendering method, schema type, performance scores, and crawler permissions.

Use SEO crawling tools to audit broken links and schema errors, then simplify HTML and implement entity-based schema beyond Article/Product.

We compare options for businesses in San Francisco and nationwide, focusing on real visibility gains over marketing claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI-crawlable sites use clean HTML, granular entity schema, fast Core Web Vitals, and allow AI crawlers in robots.txt. Regular sites often block bots or hide content in JS.
